text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "Read Committed is adequate for many applications",
      "claim_text": "Read Committed is adequate for many applications.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "The partial transaction isolation provided by Read Committed mode is adequate for many applications"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P3.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "not sufficient for all cases",
      "claim_text": "Read Committed is not sufficient for all cases.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "it is not sufficient for all cases"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P3.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "PostgreSQL's Repeatable Read allows phantom reads",
      "claim_text": "PostgreSQL's Repeatable Read allows phantom reads.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "does not allow phantom reads"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S0 says Repeatable Read does not allow phantom reads."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Changes to a sequence are rolled back when the transaction that made them aborts",
      "claim_text": "Changes to a sequence are rolled back when the transaction that made them aborts.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "are not rolled back if the transaction that made the changes aborts"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S1 says sequence changes are not rolled back on abort."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Under Read Committed, a SELECT never sees the effects of earlier updates in its own transaction until they are committed",
      "claim_text": "Under Read Committed, a SELECT never sees the effects of earlier updates in its own transaction until they are committed.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S3", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "SELECT does see the effects of previous updates executed within its own transaction, even though they are not yet committed"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P2.S3 says the opposite for Read Committed."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Repeatable Read prevents every phenomenon in the standard's table, including serialization anomalies",
      "claim_text": "Repeatable Read prevents every phenomenon in the standard's table, including serialization anomalies.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S2", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "prevents all of the phenomena described in Table 13.1 except for serialization anomalies"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S2 excludes serialization anomalies."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "After a serialization failure, the application should retry only the failed statement",
      "claim_text": "After a serialization failure, the application should retry only the failed statement.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "retry the whole transaction from the beginning"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S0 says retry the whole transaction, not just the statement."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Serializable monitoring adds no blocking beyond Repeatable Read",
      "claim_text": "Serializable monitoring adds no blocking beyond Repeatable Read.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S4", "rel": "entails", "sub": "This monitoring does not introduce any blocking beyond that present in repeatable read"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P6.S4."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "predicate locks can cause deadlocks",
      "claim_text": "Predicate locks can cause deadlocks.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "can not play any part in causing a deadlock"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S1 says predicate locks cannot cause deadlocks."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY DEFERRABLE transaction never blocks",
      "claim_text": "A SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY DEFERRABLE transaction never blocks.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S5", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "it will block until it can establish this fact"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S5 says it will block until the fact is established."
    }
  ]
}
